title: Deceptive Employment Scheme: AI-assisted hiring deception
summary: OpenAI banned accounts potentially used to facilitate a deceptive employment scheme with characteristics of publicly reported North Korea-linked IT-worker activity.
body: OpenAI banned accounts potentially used to facilitate a deceptive employment scheme with characteristics of publicly reported North Korea-linked IT-worker activity.
summaryZh: OpenAI公开宣布封禁了一批可能被用于实施欺诈性雇用计划的违规账户，这些账户带有公开报道中与朝鲜相关的IT劳工活动的特征。此举展示了大模型厂商在防范AI技术被滥用于恶意求职和网络安全威胁方面的监管治理动作。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI采取安全行动打击利用AI辅助虚假招聘与涉朝IT劳工欺诈活动的违规账号，对规范大模型安全治理具有现实警示意义。
